verdict.rationale: Google Workspace's Context-Aware Access explicitly supports conditional per-app/group policies based on user identity, location, device security status, and IP address (google-workspace-docs-15, -28, -27), which directly matches the story. However, hands-on community reports describe significant friction: no way to diagnose which policy blocked access, generic denial messages, and full device-signal enforcement effectively requiring Managed Chrome, locking out Firefox users (google-workspace-comm-1 to -4) — real operational caveats rather than a fully seamless conditional-access engine. Missing for 10: independent verification of risk-based/adaptive signals beyond device/location/IP, clearer diagnostics tooling, and cross-browser device posture parity.
